thumbs.angle: the REAL turning point — lost in 1917, not 1918

thumbs.middle: a red rubber stamp mark 'PLESS · 9 JAN 1917' on a torn timetable page lying at the foot of the hourglass

labels.where: small paper tag hanging from the hourglass frame

thumbs.angle: myth vs truth — the stab in the back
